description: This file defines the class cRootfsDobby which manages root filesystem directories for containers, including methods for directory creation, permission setup, and user/group entry management.

classes.name: cRootfsDobby
classes.description: A class representing directories on root filesystem for containers, providing functionalities to manipulate rootfs directories, set permissions, and manage user/group entries.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing cRootfsDobby with name, rootfsPath, shareRootfs, and extRootfsList.

methods.name: getPathRootfsTarget
methods.description: Returns the target path for the rootfs in the container.

methods.name: getPathRootfsHost
methods.description: Returns the host path for the rootfs.

methods.name: getConfFileHost
methods.description: Returns the path to the container's config.json file on the host.

methods.name: getPathPasswdFileTarget
methods.description: Returns the target path for the passwd file inside the container.

methods.name: getPathGroupFileTarget
methods.description: Returns the target path for the group file inside the container.

methods.name: setUpContainersRights
methods.description: Sets permissions for container directories and files using chmod commands.

methods.name: createUserGroupEntries
methods.description: Generates passwd and group files inside the container based on host /etc/passwd and /etc/group.
